gap._description: MEASURED GAPS — not a worklist of guesses. Each names its emission-site count, the existing node types an R3 implementation would read, and what the closing turn must measure. The coverage-block gate computes the denominator from implemented + ruled + gaps; these two are IN it.

gaps.label: imports
gaps.reason: 0 emission sites. src/ast/real-vba-analyzer.ts contains no RelationshipType.Imports emission at all — the only `Imports` reference in the file is an evidenceClass comparison at line 475 — and none of the 9 fixture expectation files contains an imports row. THE R3 CANDIDATE IS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: VBA has no source-level module import (references are project-level), but `Declare Function ... Lib "<library>"` and `Declare Sub ... Lib "<library>"` bind an external library procedure, and the grammar carries three library-bearing productions — declare_function_statement, declare_sub_statement and their sibling declare_statement does NOT exist (see _inventory_findings); 2 of those 3 are live named node types, with the library text carried in a field. Whether that binding IS the fleet's `imports` relation, or a different external-API fact that belongs to calls, is the gap turn's decision — taken with a site count over the admitted population. The pin's relationshipContract names imports as EXPRESSIBLE, so it is a GAP here and not a ruling.

gaps.label: overrides
gaps.reason: 0 emission sites. VBA has NO class inheritance, so there is no base-class member for an override to point at; the only same-name declaration surface is Property Get/Let/Set — three ACCESSOR declarations of ONE property — and the grammar carries property_get_declaration, property_let_declaration, property_set_declaration and conditional_property_declaration (4 named node types in all, measured in validation/m14/measurements/vba-grammar-nodes.json). Whether accessors are an override relation (they are not: no supertype exists to override, and the fleet's `overrides` means a member over a supertype member) or whether the lane must rule overrides is decided in the gap turn AFTER the R1/R2/R3 ladder is walked and recorded. The pin declares overrides a ruled gap; a ruling still needs its count and falsifier before it is admitted to coverage.excluded, so it stays a gap until then.

THE NEAR MISSES ARE MEASURED AND NAMED, NOT ASSERTED: VBA's two composition-adjacent surfaces are implements_statement — interface CONFORMANCE, 1 named node type, already published as the implements relation — and with_statement — scoping sugar over ONE receiver, 1 named node type, already published as uses; the event surface event_declaration and with_events_modifier (2 named node types) is event BINDING, the inverse direction of member composition, and it is published as calls (raise_event_statement) / metadata. excluded.label: part_of
excluded.from: VBA-D3 (2026-10-29) — GRAMMAR-ABSENCE, 0 of the 164 distinct named node types is a part-inclusion production (measurement artifact validation/m14/measurements/vba-grammar-nodes.json): 0 match include/import/part stems. The only 'fragment' names are the 3 #If partitions else_fragment, elseif_fragment and end_if_fragment, which SELECT LINES inside one module and include no other unit. VBA has NO textual inclusion of any kind — a module is referenced through the PROJECT, never spliced — and #Include does not exist in the language. preprocessor_if and preprocessor_block (2 named node types, beside the 3 fragments) are conditional COMPILATION by line selection, not part_of: the construct contains its own file's lines and names no unit. The fleet's part_of names ANOTHER UNIT AS A PART sharing one scope, and this language has no such construct. FALSIFIER: any admitted site carrying an inclusion directive the wired grammar parses into a named node — 0 measured; or any node type whose child is another module's text — 0 of 164 measured.
